capabilities: Highlight the path from a start node to an outcome
Step through large flowcharts one decision at a time
Switch layout, fit width, fit chart and zoom
Open a chosen flowchart in a separate viewer from the command palette
Render flowcharts in a standalone HTML page
disambiguation: Not a Mermaid editor or diagram generator; it only displays and steps through flowcharts already written in a note.
extras: Interface labels and commands are in Korean. A downloadable viewer.html renders flowcharts outside Obsidian and can convert sequence diagrams into flowcharts. The plugin was previously published as Mermaid Flow Viewer.
problem: Mermaid flowcharts render as static diagrams, so following one path through a long decision chart means tracing arrows by eye.

relations.evidence: If you previously installed Mermaid Flow Viewer, copy the new files into the same plugin folder

summary: Interactive viewer for Mermaid flowcharts that highlights branch paths and steps through decisions one at a time.
